agent_blueprint.description: Finds anomalies in PoroTomo DAS records that could indicate injection-induced seismicity at Brady Hot Springs, runs the detection on Aurora through PBS, and estimates the probability of a Pohang-like (Mw >= 5.5) event with the Shapiro seismogenic-index model.

metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

agent_blueprint.name: PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

session.title: porotomo-induced-seismicity: Report the headline results of the agent

answer:
Headline results of the agent run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; no PBS jobs submitted, no hazard.py run — values quoted exactly from summary.json and companion files in that run directory):

RECORDS ANALYSED
- 759 records analysed, all status "ok" (summary.json "records": analysed=759, by_status={ok:759}). Sampled at stride 20 from a 15,164-record manifest (DAS/H5/DASV/20160317–20160326), i.e. every 20th 30-s record ≈ one per 10 min. First record 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z, last 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z; sampled_fraction_of_time = 0.033141355084075994; mean_ms_per_record = 2003.9857707509884.

ANOMALIES & DAS DETECTIONS
- Anomalous records: 57 (summary.json anomalies.n_anomalous=57, z_threshold=5.0; anomalies.csv has exactly 57 rows). A record is anomalous when its max feature z-score (over z_log_band_rms, z_log_kurtosis, z_max_sta_lta, z_spectral_centroid_hz, z_n_events) exceeds 5.0. Top anomaly: 2016-03-23T20:50:17Z, zmax=30.92 (driver max_sta_lta).
- DAS detections: 62 (summary.json das_events.n=62; events.csv has 62 rows) across 53 records with events; n_scaled_to_full_time = 1870.774440052701; b_relative = 0.9849352475487246 (Aki MLE on relative magnitudes); mc_relative = -0.8492463451632817; n_above_mc = 34. Each detection is an STA/LTA trigger inside a 30-s record with uncalibrated relative magnitudes (mrel, NOT ML).

SEISMOGENIC INDEX Sigma AND P(Mw>=5.5) PER YEAR PER b SCENARIO (summary.json "hazard_catalog_based" — Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5, P = 1 − exp(−V·10^(Sigma − b·M)), calibrated against the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue: GDR 859, n=5 ML events, mc=-0.48, mag_max=0.07):
- b = 1.0: Sigma = -5.448901270028832; P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 5.235629034316958e-06; P(Mw>=5.5) per year at observed rate = 0.00011982478978644906 (≈1.20e-4/yr)
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.3193012700288325; P over observed volume = 0.00021553767643867072; per year = 0.004921548824626587 (≈4.92e-3/yr)
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.280901270028833; P over observed volume = 0.0006483793467004784; per year = 0.014735103451029574 (≈1.47e-2/yr)

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (summary.json "hazard_das_upper_bound"):
- b_used = 0.9849352475487246 (DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE); Sigma = -2.698279919032152
- P(Mw>=5.5): over observed volume = 0.0024076054468051833; per year at observed rate = 0.07842182774171746 (≈7.84e-2/yr). (Also M>=3.0: 0.5028935333666842 over volume / 0.9999999999480303 per yr; M>=4.0: 0.06980604371234655 / 0.9138460482144991.)

WHICH IS CALIBRATED AND WHICH IS AN UPPER BOUND
- The CALIBRATED probability is the catalog-based estimate ("hazard_catalog_based", the Sigma / P(Mw>=5.5) values per b scenario above): it rests on the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue with calibrated ML magnitudes and Shapiro et al. (2021) Eq. 5.
- The DAS-based number ("hazard_das_upper_bound", Sigma = -2.698279919032152, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842182774171746) is an UNCALIBRATED UPPER BOUND: it treats every DAS detection as an event at or above the catalogue minimum magnitude (over-counting) and uses uncalibrated relative magnitudes (mrel), so it must not be quoted as a calibrated probability. (Note: interpretation.md's "Calibration note" calling the DAS bound the calibrated estimate is explicitly flagged as wrong by the reviewer note at the top of that file.)

ASSUMPTIONS / CONTEXT
- Stride-20 sampling of the 15,164-record manifest (≈3.31% of the time window) underlies all counts; detections scaled to full time via n_scaled_to_full_time = 1870.774440052701.
- Anomaly z-scores computed per record over the five listed features with threshold 5.0.
- Pumping context (summary.json "pumping", GDR 917): 2016-03-11T08:00Z→2016-03-27T07:00Z (15.958333333333334 days); injected 465448.11344981275 m³, extracted 505933.04934013565 m³, net -40484.9358903229 m³; hourly Spearman events vs net injection = -0.1727533876579381.
- Pohang reference (summary.json "pohang"): reference Sigma range [-2.0,-1.0], b in {0.65, 0.73}, mainshock Mw 5.5, worst-case probabilities [0.15, 0.17]. Sigma needed at Brady for a 1% chance of Mw>=5.5 over the observed volume: b=1.0 → -2.16569069948543, b=0.73 → -3.6506906994854305, b=0.65 → -4.09069069948543 — the site Sigma (-5.45 to -5.28) is far below these, i.e. well under a 1% chance of Mw>=5.5 over the observed volume.
- Run provenance: PBS job 9092130.aurora-pbs-0001.hostmgmt.cm.aurora.alcf.anl.gov, 2 nodes × 24 ranks = 48 ranks, manifest 759 records, start 2026-11-15T15:57:45Z; detect finished in 188 s at 2026-11-15T16:00:53Z; hazard finished at 2026-11-15T16:00:56Z. 6 records initially download_failed (SSL errors) and were recovered via retry, giving the final 759 ok.

Bottom line: of 759 analysed PoroTomo DAS records, 57 were anomalous (z>5) and 62 DAS STA/LTA detections were found. The calibrated (LBNL-catalogue) seismogenic index is Sigma ≈ -5.45 to -5.28, giving P(Mw>=5.5) ≈ 1.2e-4 to 1.5e-2 per year for b = 1.0 to 0.65. The DAS-based figure (Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5) ≈ 0.078/yr) is an uncalibrated over-counting upper bound with relative magnitudes, not a calibrated probability.
